notes: Variant assumption: bilateral dumbbell row performed prone or chest-supported on an incline bench. The strongest close source is prone barbell row EMG because it fixes the torso and measures latissimus dorsi, transverse trapezius, rear deltoid, and biceps brachii. Garcia-Jaen et al. was used for the standing versus bench-supported row posture distinction, not as the only muscle-role anchor. No visible erector spinae or oblique support was added because the chest pad materially reduces trunk demand and the app card should stay focused. Rhomboids are marked as inference from grouped row EMG and scapular-retraction mechanics. Local anatomy mesh mappings resolve for all visible muscles.
